line segment.definition: The shortest path between two points with fixed length.

line.definition: A straight path extending infinitely in both directions.

ray.definition: A path starting at one point and extending infinitely in one direction.

angles.summary: Figures formed by two rays sharing a common vertex.

angle.definition: A figure formed by two rays with a common vertex.

obtuse angle.definition: An angle greater than 90° and less than 180°.

reflex angle.definition: An angle greater than 180° and less than 360°.

angle measurement.summary: Methods and units used to measure angles.

degree.definition: The standard unit used to measure angles.

protractor.definition: An instrument used to measure angles.

drawing angles.definition: Constructing an angle using a protractor.

angle bisector.definition: A ray that divides an angle into two equal angles.

comparing angles.definition: Determining which angle is larger by measurement or comparison.

rotation.definition: Turning around a point; angles measure rotation.
